name: 99362 · Walla Walla, WA
findings: ZIP 99362 (Walla Walla) has 184 nonprofit organizations. 83 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 99362 (Walla Walla) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 99362 (Walla Walla) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
